mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly increases the cost of capital for corporations, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of observations when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0% (as measured by the 20-day return sign over a 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that triggers a monetary policy response, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of observations when UNRATE is above 5.0% (over a 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in the demand for goods and services, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 40% of instances (i.e., positive returns in >40% of triggered cases) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) indicates a contraction in the real economy that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and GDPC1 fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 40% of instances (i.e., positive returns in >40% of triggered cases) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (when the federal funds rate is rising and above 4.5%), the Fed's policy action reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising (over a 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE above 5.0%), the labor market weakness suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window.
